definitions.explanation: A cooperative arrangement or business partnership between organizations for mutual benefit.

examples.japanese: A{社|しゃ}とB{社|しゃ}が{業務|ぎょうむ}{提携|ていけい}を{結|むす}んだ。
examples.english: Company A and Company B formed a business alliance.

examples.japanese: {提携|ていけい}カードで{割引|わりびき}が{受|う}けられる。
examples.english: You can get a discount with the partner card.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}{企業|きぎょう}との{提携|ていけい}を{進|すす}める。
examples.english: To advance partnerships with overseas companies.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {業務|ぎょうむ}{提携|ていけい}: business alliance
- {資本|しほん}{提携|ていけい}: capital alliance
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}{提携|ていけい}: technical partnership
- {提携|ていけい}を{結|むす}ぶ: to form a partnership
- {提携|ていけい}カード: affiliated card
- {提携|ていけい}{先|さき}: partner (company)

RELATED TERMS:
- {連携|れんけい}: cooperation, coordination
- {協力|きょうりょく}: cooperation
- {合弁|ごうべん}: joint venture
